eyebrow: Cross-Platform Relational Database Administration · Chapter Sixteen
subtitle: Lesson 82 · PostgreSQL Replication & High Availability

code:
-- On the source database
CREATE PUBLICATION sales_pub
  FOR TABLE orders, order_items;

-- On the destination database
CREATE SUBSCRIPTION sales_sub
  CONNECTION 'host=source_db dbname=sales user=repl_user'
  PUBLICATION sales_pub;
caption: Subscriber tables must already exist with a matching structure before changes start applying.
